limitations.note: The patch left the warning lights combinational instead of registering them on the rising edge using the pre-edge balance, and rewrote billing to deduct a fee on recharge cycles that should only add money.
The passing testbench encoded the patch’s assumptions, expecting a fee on recharge and immediate warning changes rather than checking the registered warning timing and recharge priority.

limitations.quote: A clocked decode using a nonblocking assignment samples the pre-edge value
limitations.note: The agent read the relevant timing guide but did not use its before-and-after-edge comparison to diagnose the warning outputs.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: An unnecessary Git check in a non-repository blocked the initial file read, and a rejected cleanup command forced the test launch to be resubmitted.
